meta.name: document-gen-resilient
meta.description: Multi-path document generation with tool checks, Unicode handling, and Python fallbacks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多种方式生成文档，自动处理编码和工具缺失问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要可靠地生成文档并处理各种异常情况
copy.tagline_en: Generate documents with multiple fallback paths, handling Unicode and missing tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need reliable document generation with error handling

howto.what: 它会自动检查系统里的文档转换工具（如pandoc），如果生成PDF时遇到乱码或缺少工具，会尝试用Python后备方案，并替你处理好特殊字符。
howto.when: 当你要求生成文档（特别是PDF）、之前的文档生成失败、或文档里含有非英文字符时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份含©和→符号的PDF报告。

say.note: 它会分步用pandoc转换，遇到问题会回退到其他方法。

say.text: 生成一份中文合同PDF，确保不乱码。
say.note: 它会自动判定Unicode字符，选择合适的引擎或做字符替换。

howto.what_en: On document generation tasks, it checks for tools like pandoc, handles Unicode, and falls back to Python libraries if needed, to ensure reliable multi-format output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when document generation (especially PDF) encounters errors, needs special characters, or previous attempts failed.

say_en.text: Generate a PDF report with © and → symbols.
say_en.note: It checks tools and uses xelatex or Python fallback to avoid encoding issues.

say_en.text: Convert that Markdown to Word and HTML.
say_en.note: It uses pandoc step by step, falling back if needed.

say_en.text: Create a Chinese contract PDF without garbled text.
say_en.note: It handles Unicode by selecting appropriate engine or sanitizing.
